findings.body: Two overlapping `forge doctor --fix` runs can both select `forge-files` before either creates it. Once the first creates the worktree, the second's checkout attempt fails because the branch exists (`src/forge/task.py:116`). This handler then sees that branch in `story.worktrees(top)` and calls `_drop`, force-removing the first run's worktree and deleting its branch. Any uncommitted work there is lost. Worktree membership does not establish ownership; cleanup must distinguish a checkout this invocation created from an existing checkout that caused creation to fail.
findings.title: Only remove a fix created by this doctor run
